verdict_reason: All 5 screenshot findings remain addressed. Original cleanup commit 255899d was followed by committed first release-gate repair 6f2fa02, and this second follow-up narrows bootstrap filters so legitimate MCP, <INSTRUCTIONS>, and AGENTS prompts stay visible while real bootstrap/system context stays hidden. Targeted tests, full mmschat node tests, git diff --check, and xcodebuild all pass. Hard boundaries held.

commit_lineage.message: fix(mmschat): filter codex rollout context roles

worktree_clean: expected true after committing tracked changes and result artifacts

screenshot_findings_addressed.title: Duplicate-looking titles fixed
screenshot_findings_addressed.summary: Replaced generic titles in replay entries with real prompt titles from the rollout data, falling back to the rollout id when prompt text is unavailable.

screenshot_findings_addressed.title: Bootstrap/context records hidden
screenshot_findings_addressed.summary: Bootstrap and context records are now excluded from the rollout list, detail view, item count, and title generation. These internal records no longer leak into user-facing UI.

screenshot_findings_addressed.title: Empty Thinking placeholders suppressed
screenshot_findings_addressed.summary: Thinking/reasoning entries with empty or whitespace-only content no longer produce placeholder rows.

screenshot_findings_addressed.title: Read-only replay preserved
screenshot_findings_addressed.summary: Rollout detail remains read-only on iOS. Existing phone localization/copy documents historical replay behavior; no Swift changes required.

screenshot_findings_addressed.title: Session-meta-only empty rollouts suppressed
screenshot_findings_addressed.summary: Rollout entries that contain only session_meta records and no meaningful transcript content are excluded from the list and count.

details.summary: Added role check in normalizeCodexRolloutMessage so system and developer role messages are hidden before they enter chat, counts, or titles. This prevents internal context instructions from appearing as user-visible chat bubbles.
Committed coverage in 6f2fa02 verifies role-filtering behavior, title fallback coverage, and a bootstrap false-positive guard for ordinary role prompts.

details.change: bootstrap matcher narrowed to explicit injected forms
details.summary: Narrowed AGENTS.md, <INSTRUCTIONS>, and MCP bootstrap patterns so legitimate user prompts mentioning MCP, <INSTRUCTIONS>, or AGENTS remain visible unless they match the actual injected bootstrap shapes.

details.change: negative regression coverage for legitimate prompts
details.summary: Added negative assertions proving real prompts containing MCP, <INSTRUCTIONS>, and AGENTS text are not misclassified as bootstrap context.

validation.command: xcodebuild -project CodexMobile/CodexMobile.xcodeproj -scheme CodexMobile -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17" -derivedDataPath .build/p8k-codex-rollout-phone-polish-derived CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build

residual_risks: No phone reinstall, on-device verification, or main-apply/merge was performed in this session.
Real live send, resume, open-visible, and kill flows were not exercised; validation remained targeted tests, full node tests, diff check, and compile only per boundary.
Result artifacts intentionally record the second repair as pending commit because they are included in the commit payload; final commit hash must be reported out-of-band after commit.
HumanGate is still needed before any live deployment or device validation to confirm legitimate MCP, <INSTRUCTIONS>, and AGENTS prompts render correctly on phone.
